name: tronagenticstar
description: Agentic AI Platform with multi-agent orchestration

scripts.dev: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && echo 'Development environment started'
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && cd tests && npm test
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules/.cache && npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && find . -name 'dist' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name '__pycache__' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules tests/node_modules
